Markdown table editor

Tap a cell to edit it, or drag the handles to move cells. Add cells with the + and − buttons on the bar under the table. Paste cells from a spreadsheet and the table grows to fit. The source stays a plain Markdown table that any app can read.

Also: Free online Markdown editor · Markdown to PDF

Questions

How do I make a new table?

Tap + on the bar under the text, then the table button.

Can I paste from Excel or Google Sheets?

Yes. Paste the cells and they become a Markdown table.

Is it free?

Yes. Rapier is free and open source, with no account, ads or tracking.
